title: Install endpoints have no operator authentication and the 'one-time lock' is per-session, so a fresh session bypasses it
test_evidence: failing-first: vitest src/app/api/install/install-global-lock.security.test.ts src/lib/api-client.test.ts against parent-commit sources -> 12 failed/21; with fix 21/21; Playwright chromium smoke 10 passed 1 skipped (commits 74e35a4c, 8605ffd8)
notes: Topic 1 Option A approved 2026-10-27 (owner dbn1972). Scheduled in owner-tracks batch t1-install-tenant-batch2. POST /api/install/session requires INSTALL_BOOTSTRAP_SECRET (secret manager; constant-time; unset -> 503) in x-install-bootstrap-secret; the installed lock is one O_EXCL file at INSTALL_LOCK_FILE (required when NODE_ENV is production-like, else 503) seen by every session/process/restart -> 409; wizard UI asks the operator for the secret first. Rollout: deployments must set INSTALL_BOOTSTRAP_SECRET and INSTALL_LOCK_FILE on a persistent volume (compose/helm not edited; the wizard fails closed until supplied).

title: Endpoint/URL config accepted with no scheme or host restrictions; connectivity errors unguarded
test_evidence: failing-first: vitest src/endpoint-policy.ssrf.test.ts against parent-commit sources -> 17 failed/18; with fix 18/18 (commit fae8e0e9)
notes: Topic 2 Option A approved 2026-10-27 (owner dbn1972). Scheduled in owner-tracks batch t1-install-tenant-batch2. Install HTTP plugin always applies the SSRF policy to URL fields (CDN baseUrl + invalidationEndpoint, storage endpoint, SQS endpoint/queueUrlPrefix: https; RabbitMQ: amqps): DNS-resolved, private/loopback/link-local/metadata refused; explicit exact-host allow-list INSTALL_ENDPOINT_ALLOWED_HOSTS (wildcards refused; loopback/link-local/metadata never allowed); connectivity testers time-boxed (10 s) and exceptions contained. Not policed: DB/Redis host fields (not URLs) and the local operator CLI tools/install-cli (trusted, not network exposed).

title: Domain removal and lifecycle inputs partly ignored: decommission exportData flag and 'sessions invalidated' promises have no implementation
test_evidence: failing-first: vitest src/tenant-decommission-lifecycle.test.ts against parent-commit sources -> 5 failed/6; with fix 6/6 (commit 5664bb98)
notes: Topic 1 Option A approved 2026-10-27 (owner dbn1972). Scheduled in owner-tracks batch t1-install-tenant-batch2. Met: exportData (default true) honoured - an injected TenantDataExporter runs before the status change (failure aborts), otherwise the obligation is recorded pending and permanent deletion is refused until met; exportData:false records a waiver; decommission unverifies custom domains and invalidates the resolver cache; sessions: the gateway lifecycle listener already revokes all sessions on a blocking status (apps/api-gateway/src/app.ts:1105-1114, cited). Unmet: no production TenantDataExporter is wired in the gateway (needs app.ts tenantLifecyclePlugin options, outside this batch) so a decommission via the console leaves the export pending and the tenant undeletable until an exporter (format + destination) exists.

notes: Topic 4 Option A approved 2026-10-27 (owner dbn1972). Scheduled in owner-tracks batch t1-install-tenant-batch2. 256-bit challenge on add; POST /api/v1/tenant-lifecycle/:id/domains/:domainId/verify (mounted beside add-domain; segment tenant-lifecycle -> platform, same guard; mutating-route-authz.ts not edited; design text said /api/v1/tenants which platform-admin UI owns); DNS TXT _proctira-verify.<domain> or HTTPS well-known via safeFetch (redirects off, 200, <=1 KiB, exact trimmed token); verifyDomainExclusive under pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtext) in one withPlatformScope txn (409 for a current verification elsewhere; lapsed ones cleared); 30-day expiry; resolver refuses !=1 verified row or lapsed verification; recheck ticker (6 h default, unref) DR4-8: claim <=50 rows under pg_try_advisory_xact_lock and COMMIT, network checks outside any txn, one short txn per result; failed recheck unverifies + invalidates cache.

title: Public tenant resolver does a full-table scan of all tenant/domain documents on every anonymous request, uncached
test_evidence: failing-first: vitest src/public-tenant-resolver.cache.test.ts against parent-commit sources -> 3 failed/5; with fix 5/5 (commit a720f01f); EXPLAIN ANALYZE on a 300k-row control_plane_documents copy uses Bitmap Index Scan on control_plane_documents_data_gin
notes: Topic 4 Option A approved 2026-10-27 (owner dbn1972). Scheduled in owner-tracks batch t1-install-tenant-batch2. Domain lookup via JSONB containment (GIN jsonb_path_ops index) and slug via tenants.slug unique index / GIN; per-replica bounded LRU (1000) with 30 s TTL capped at the verification expiry; tenant status re-read by primary key on every request so suspension is immediate on every replica (status is never cached, so no bus subscription is needed); domain remove/verify/unverify invalidate in-process; other replicas converge within the TTL.

notes: Topic 4 Option A approved 2026-10-27 (owner dbn1972). Scheduled in owner-tracks batch t1-install-tenant-batch2. Met: createSandbox provisions a real isolated tenant (TenantService.provisionSandboxTenant: own id/slug, sandbox:true, seeded defaults, active) through the root tenantService decorator (no domain-plugins.ts edit) and fails closed without a provisioner; destroy tears the tenant down first (decommission 0-day + export waiver + permanent delete through legal-hold and destructive-delete guards); a lost limit race tears the orphan down. title: SSR tenant theme fetch targets an endpoint no backend serves; tenant branding never on first paint
test_evidence: failing-first: registration public-branding.test.ts vs parent sources -> 7 failed/7; gateway public-branding-gateway.test.ts vs parent -> 3 failed/3; web server.test.ts vs parent server.ts -> 4 failed/51; all pass with fix (commit d4abfd21)
notes: Topic 4 Option A approved 2026-10-27 (owner dbn1972). Scheduled in owner-tracks batch t1-install-tenant-batch2. GET /api/v1/registrations/branding: tenant only from the request Host via the gateway verified resolver (test fallback and x-tenant-id ignored); ?slug accepted only when equal to the Host tenant slug (else 404); allow-listed fields only (slug, name, logoUrl, faviconUrl, primaryColor, accentColor); 60 reads/min/client then 429. Placed on the registration public surface because making a tenant-lifecycle route public needs app.ts (outside this batch); reads branding via the root tenantService decorator. SSR fetch forwards the incoming Host with node:http(s) (fetch cannot set Host), 3 s / 16 KiB caps, cache keyed by Host+slug; no usable Host -> DEFAULT_BRAND without fetching.
